evidence: The Alternative.me Fear & Greed Index recorded a reading of 13 ('Extreme Fear') on May 19, following consecutive days of deeply depressed sentiment (7-day average of 10.86). While prolonged extreme fear can create conditions for occasional technical oversold relief bounces, entrenched single-digit to low-teens readings indicate severe ongoing structural stress and absent buyer conviction following market contagion. Although the score crept up slightly from the recent trough of 8, market sentiment remains pinned in deep distress, marginally tilting the 24-hour balance of probabilities against an upward close.
limitations: Fear & Greed Index is a lagging composite sentiment proxy and does not directly capture order-book dynamics or intraday spot liquidity.
Snapshot availability and later revisions are caller-attested, not independently verified.
